name: Geode mod
summary: A Geometry Dash mod for the Geode loader: mod.json, CMakeLists.txt and a main.cpp that hooks the main menu.
description: A C++ project that builds into a .geode package. mod.json must name the exact Geode and Geometry Dash versions it is built for, or the loader refuses the mod. The example hooks MenuLayer and adds a button to the main menu.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Developer
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: Goes into the mod ID, which must never change once people use the mod.

options.label: Description
options.help: Shown in the mod list in game.

options.label: Geode version
options.help: The exact version of the Geode SDK you build with. It is in the VERSION file of the SDK folder (the GEODE_SDK environment variable).

options.label: Geometry Dash version
options.help: The exact game version the mod is for. The loader refuses the mod on any other version.

options.label: Node IDs mod version
options.help: The oldest geode.node-ids the mod accepts. The example finds the menu by its node ID, which that mod provides.

next: Install the Geode CLI and SDK first (geode sdk install), plus CMake and a C++ compiler.
In the project folder run: geode build
With a CLI profile set up the mod is installed into Geometry Dash. Otherwise copy build\{{ModId}}.geode to geode\mods in the game folder.
Start Geometry Dash: there is a new button on the main menu.
